title: Co$^2$ODE: Conditionally Coarse-Grained Model Discovery for Rewiring in Biochemical Networks
summary: Selected markers carry predictive information, while coarse-graining costs little and mismatched markers increase error in biochemical-network observations. Learned context-conditioned latent dynamics select markers and infer rewiring-related effective structures. Testing: The result is validated within reported biochemical-network datasets and controls.. Methods §§3–4 define Co²ODE context-conditioned state selection and learned dynamics; Results §5 report coarse-graining, marker-swap and prior-knowledge comparisons on biochemical-network observations.
